title: A viewer sees and signs out their devices; an operator revokes any
description: Serves "Joining and signing in are easy and safe."; "Access is enforced everywhere.". Each sign-in belongs to a device (D-082).
acceptanceCriteria: A viewer lists their signed-in devices (name, app, last seen) and signs any of them out; an administrator does the same for any account.
A device signed out answers 401 on its next request through any api or stream replica, shown with real processes.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
